name: Bird-of-paradise shrub
desc: Bird-of-paradise shrub (Erythrostemon gilliesii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erythrostemon gilliesii is a shrub in the legume family. It is commonly known as bird of paradise, but it is not related to the bird of paradise genus Strelitzia.
